checksums.entries_representation: ordered array of closed {name,bytes,digest} rows; unique name checked independently of JSON object shape

delivery_history.acknowledgement: Only literal synchronous true confirms the configured trusted transport handoff. False/throw/thenable/invalid return leaves outcome_unknown. Never await or execute an untrusted then method to improve the result. Callback itself may already have sent data.
delivery_history.disposal: Disposal closes authority and clears secrets best effort but retains the redacted per-token delivery history while its token/owning Read remains reachable, so a later failure cannot erase past attempts.
delivery_history.limits: not_invoked only means this token has not invoked this API transport callback. It is not proof that the trusted Host did not send its already received body through another route. confirmed means configured handoff acknowledgement, not confirmed remote receipt; outcome_unknown may include partial or full external disclosure.
delivery_history.monotonicity: History is not_invoked until side-effect invocation; then outcome_unknown; then confirmed only on actual acknowledgement. Never downgrade or discard attempt_id/times after throw, expiry, revocation, disposal, repeated call or final Read failure. Returned observations are frozen values at their return time; later observations report accumulated state. A retained earlier not_invoked observation cannot prove later nondisclosure.
delivery_history.outer_settlement: A prepared token can initiate commit only while its owning Host callback is active. Callback settlement closes unused authority. If a commit remains reserved or awaits authorization/scope when the outer callback settles, the owning Read returns body-free delivery_failed with zero new handles; later promise resolution/rejection cannot invoke a side effect. Preserve consumed history. Host-only true succeeds only when no failed or pending commit exists.
delivery_history.reentrancy: Private in-flight reservation is taken at commit entry before calling any external provider/clock callback; same-token concurrent or reentrant entry cannot start another observation or attempt. Recheck token/generation at every await. Before side-effect invocation, atomically consume token and install outcome_unknown. A pre-invocation failure closes this prepared token with not_invoked. No automatic retry; later calls return existing history only.
delivery_history.scope: Exactly one prepared token belongs to each protected Read attempt. Every post-preparation success/failure and commit result reports the same accumulated private history. Deferred new delivery requires a new protected Read with fresh checks and cannot replace an earlier token/history. Once commit fails or is outcome_unknown, later Host true cannot promote that Read to ready. Host-only success with not_invoked makes no external-delivery claim. Separate operations never import caller-supplied history.
delivery_history.scope_recheck: Compare the full prepared body to the existing scopeBody result on a clone; filtering any content requires a new Read, even when scopeBody returns true. Final local checks after clock callbacks recheck disposed and generation.
delivery_history.times: Host at_ms <= attempted_at_ms <= confirmed_at_ms when available. attempted_at_ms is captured by the final trusted local check immediately before consumption. Record confirmed_at_ms from the next valid trusted-clock sample after literal true; if clock fails/rolls back, preserve confirmed with null and return a body-free provider failure. A committed success requires non-null confirmed_at_ms equal to committed_at_ms. No known timestamp may later become null.
delivery_history.transition: available -> consumed/outcome_unknown is one synchronous private transition after awaited authorization/scope observations and final local checks, before calling the transport side-effect callback. No external code runs inside that transition.

non_schema_rules.future_boundary: Source observations alone do not prove actual protected Node runtime behavior.
non_schema_rules.future_owner: Core/Read protection integration and trusted Host
non_schema_rules.requirement: Manifest entitlement is optional. Absence adds no credential, lease, offline or revocable default. With presence, access must be licensed, payload encrypted true, encryption exactly payload.kdnab and profile/version must match password->kdna.envelope.aead/0.1.0 or account/org->kdna.envelope.external-grant/0.1.0. Apply to every bytes/source/producer path before payload disclosure. Existing protection markers preserve ordinary capability rejection; new malformed entitlement-only plaintext rejects as Core invalid.

non_schema_rules.requirement: Protected admission returns full IR only to a trusted Core caller already authorized to receive it. Same-instance opaque operations govern later controlled operations, not recall of copied IR. Pure inspect/project/Plan/Capsule do not gain clock/store/network I/O or online authority. non_schema_rules.requirement: Final check then callback invocation discloses body to trusted Host. Awaiting callback across expiry cannot erase that disclosure. External transport commit separately obtains current operation validity and current Host scope. In one synchronous private transition before invoking the side-effect callback, consume the prepared token and record a unique attempt as outcome_unknown. The callback acknowledgement true confirms only its configured trusted transport handoff boundary, never remote receipt. False, throw or any thenable remains outcome_unknown even if bytes were sent. Reentrant or later reuse cannot invoke the callback again, create a new attempt or downgrade prior history. Confirmed history survives subsequent Host failure, expiry, revocation and provider error; a valid monotonic current-invocation post-ack sample is preserved even when authorization fails; an invalid, rollback, unavailable or uncalled post-ack clock records confirmed_at_ms null in the body-free failure, never an invented timestamp. Failure carries no prepared body, no ready/delivered result, and registers no new handle. No automatic retry or restoration of consumed authority. Delayed transport must acquire a distinct authorized prepared delivery at its actual handoff; no result claims global nondisclosure by a trusted Host outside this API.

non_schema_rules.future_boundary: Source observations alone do not prove actual protected Node runtime behavior.
non_schema_rules.future_owner: Core/Read protection integration and trusted Host
non_schema_rules.requirement: R2-bound closed result unions separate actual Core failure and protection/delivery failures. All four Read modes reject unknown critical semantics with READ_UNSUPPORTED_CRITICAL; no catalog_only admission or delivery arm is active. Diagnostic references are bound to the complete R2 tuple and package combination by schema_binding. Historical pre-R2 schemas and the complete original definition remain separate and unchanged. JSON observations and receipts never create operation authority. request_failed may carry the actual rejected Read envelope only from request version dispatch (READ_MIXED_VERSION_TUPLE or READ_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION at stage version, original not_evaluated states, empty source coordinates, not_delivered receipt and exact budget). Tiny budgets preserve no_body_control. No bind/Host action or ProtectionReceipt occurs. Schema-valid later-stage rejection alone does not qualify. Binding observe/assertCurrent failures use closed ProtectionCurrentFailure with checked_at_ms UInt|null, sampled only in the current invocation. Each clock attempt resets the observation; valid monotonic samples survive later authorization/disposal rejection, while invalid/rollback/unavailable/uncalled samples are null. A timestamp is observation, not authority. Public failures project only status and diagnostic.

non_schema_rules.requirement: offline/revocable absent remain unprovided. offline=false forbids offline grant use; offline=true requires a verified signed grace window and integration offline capability and does not create a window. revocable=true requires external grant plus trusted issuer status/refresh/revocation capability; password possession alone conflicts. revocable=false states no requested revocation feature and never disables actual issuer revoke/expiry. Capability conflicts reject, never silently ignore. Canonical password admission in this local Node module conflicts with offline=false because possession is locally usable.

non_schema_rules.requirement: checksums.document/1 is a new closed document. Raw duplicate JSON keys reject; 1 MiB document cap, 2..128 entries, names <=4096 UTF8 bytes, member bytes <=8 MiB, total original container limits unchanged. Entries and covered_entries are the same strictly UTF8-sorted exact runtimeEntryNames set. Each entry bytes/digest matches original raw bytes. E0.2 equals entry_set_digest; A and checksums/signature themselves are not covered. Old0.1 is not relabeled.

non_schema_rules.requirement: Trusted expectation binds account_id, exact entitlement_id, account/org entitlement profile, device ID and both distinct device public keys, asset UID/ID/version, captured original A, entry, ciphertext digest, key_ref, issuer asset key ID and pinned issuer signing key ID. Never trust grant self-asserted expectation. Per exact issuer/account_id/entitlement_id high-water shared across devices, per-device records keyed separately, all verified status/time updates atomic. Provider/clock rollback/store failures close. Offline use only explicitly requested within signed grace/expiry and authored allowance; no instant disconnected revocation promise.

proof_limits: Definitions, static examples and generated shapes alone do not prove protected runtime capability.
Opaque runtime types compile to false in JSON Schema; an observation validates no brand or grant.
Source/schema/generator results alone do not prove ordinary runtime presence rejection.
A contract observation alone does not prove actual restricted-window semantic behavior.
r2_interpretation: Unknown critical semantics reject in all modes; no ProtectedAdmissionCatalogOnly result/observation arm.
